create_flux_controlnet_img2img_pipeline: create a Flux ControlNet image-to-image pipeline with control guidance for conditioned image generation
encode_flux_controlnet_prompt: encode text prompts into CLIP and T5 embeddings with LoRA scaling for Flux ControlNet generation
prepare_flux_controlnet_latents: prepare image-to-image latents by encoding init image, adding noise at a given timestep, and packing for Flux transformer
run_flux_controlnet_inference: run the Flux ControlNet image-to-image pipeline with control images, strength, and guidance for conditioned generation
unpack_flux_controlnet_latents: unpack Flux transformer latents back to image space by reversing packing and VAE decoding for final image output
